caption: A first-person view from the nose of a white surfboard, its black stringer dividing the deck, floats in turquoise water while the frame sits at a diagonal tilt. Ahead, a band of breaking-wave foam churns across the center, and a tree-covered headland lined with high-rise buildings anchors the left horizon. On the right, a loose line of distant surfers bobs near the water's edge under a blue sky scattered with clouds. The whitewater draws closer as the foam rolls and spreads, broadening from a thin mid-distance line into a churned expanse that fills the lower and central view. The board's nose, prominent along the bottom edge early on with white wake beside it, shrinks and drops out of frame. The horizon's tilt shifts throughout, the coastline landmarks sliding slowly as the roll varies. Water droplets speckle the lens, multiplying and enlarging as the view closes. They increasingly obscure the scene while the surfers and headland hold their positions relative to the horizon.
